D1_default_object_person_vs_intended.description: Object noun dropped/omitted, so the grammar's DEFAULT_OBJECT 'person' is used even when the utterance context (parking, truck, bus, ...) implies a vehicle or other object. Syntactically valid, semantically divergent.

D2_default_cooldown_60s_vs_intended_urge.description: Urgency wording (critical/high) does not change cooldown_sec, which stays at the documented 60 s default. Syntactically valid, semantically divergent.

D3_night_window_20_06_vs_intended_daytim.description: A daytime utterance is rewritten to 'at night', but the intended window was 06:00-20:00; the grammar maps 'night' to 20:00-06:00. Syntactically valid, semantically divergent.

D3_night_window_20_06_vs_intended_evenin.description: 'at night' is used where an evening window (18:00-22:00) was intended; the grammar maps 'night' to 20:00-06:00. Syntactically valid, semantically divergent.
